description: A second point and digits after a fractional part make an invalid number literal
notes: By the grammar, 1.2.3 is the literal 1.2 followed by the legacy index operator .3, which parses and only fails when evaluated. The reference scanner's NumberLit rule in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl reads 1.2.3 as one token, and numberLitValue in parser.go then rejects it.
